title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Michael Jackson?
description: Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Michael Jackson, through Vichy France's Marshal Pétain, a young François Mitterrand and Ronald Reagan.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Michael Jackson?
fun_fact: Pétain stood beside President Hoover at Yorktown's 150th anniversary in October 1931. Exactly 50 years later, on 19 October 1981, Mitterrand stood there with Reagan for the 200th.
research_note: The 1942 photo of Pétain receiving Mitterrand stayed out of sight for 52 years until it appeared on the cover of a 1994 book, and it links Vichy straight to a president who later stood beside Reagan.

image.file: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-H25217, Henry Philippe Petain und Adolf Hitler.jpg

links.line: In 1940, Hitler shook hands with France's Marshal Pétain.
In 1942, Pétain met a young François Mitterrand, a future president.
In 1981, President Mitterrand joined Ronald Reagan at Yorktown.
And in 1984, at the White House, Reagan honored Michael Jackson.
